title: Antisymmetry of the symplectic form
statement: Fix a prime $p$ and an integer $n$, and equip $V = \bbf_p^n \times \bbf_p^n$ with the bilinear form $\omega(u,v) = \sum_{i=0}^{n-1}(x_i z'_i - z_i x'_i)$, where $u = (x,z)$ and $v = (x',z')$. Then $\omega$ is antisymmetric: for all $u, v \in V$, \[ \omega(u,v) = -\,\omega(v,u). \]
hypotheses_covered: u, v range over V = F_p^n × F_p^n
